portslade.name: Portslade Level Crossing
portslade._comment_chain: The berth chain a train steps through towards and past the crossing, per direction, nearest-last on the way in. {x:true} is the crossing itself. gap = median seconds in that berth; role marks the approach/protecting/clear berths; ttc = {q1,med,q3} seconds from ENTERING an approach berth to the train passing the crossing; tac = the same from passing the crossing to entering a cleared berth. Reference for both = the train stepping out of the protecting berth (the TRAIN on the crossing, not the barrier). Measured over 28 days of TD logs (backend scripts/derive-ttc.js). Read by shared/predict.js (PREDICT.setChain): position labels, the feedback picker ranking and the observer map. Moved here verbatim from a constant in predict.js on 2026-11-06 (multi-crossing item 6) so the shared code carries no Portslade data; a crossing without a chain shows every train as elsewhere in the area.
portslade._comment_offChainEta: Observer only: berths beyond the drawn chain that still lead to the crossing, with median seconds-to-crossing from TD timestamps. Orders the observer list of other trains in the area; berths not listed sort by recency. Seeded from one day; refine via derive-chain. Moved here verbatim from observe.js on 2026-11-06.
portslade._comment_confidenceWindows: Heuristic defaults — to be calibrated against empirical TD event logs once sufficient data is collected
